About

A life made of frames
and things built.

I'm Aiden Jinseo Choi — a maker who moves between a camera and a code editor, splitting a life between Seoul and Vancouver.

Photography is where it started: a way to slow the world down and keep the moments that would otherwise pass — quiet streets, harbour light, a skyline holding its breath at night. The lens is how I notice things.

The rest grew from the same restlessness. I build iOS apps like ThinkTwin, handcraft artisan keycaps under AC Studios, and chase good food and drink on my YouTube channel. Different mediums, one instinct — make something worth looking at twice.

Right now I'm doing my service in the Korean military, still creating in the margins. This site is where it all lives.
